title: Story Saver, Story Downloader
summary: Download story video, photo & reels and repost using story saver, downloader
description:
We have introduced Story Saver, Save all the stories, videos, and reels from this app. The app is free and now we can download stories of friends in a few minutes.

Now you can save not only your stories but also tags, captions, and music. Story Saver app will help you to save your videos, take pictures, and save stories. You can also download your favorite videos for offline watching. We know how important it is for you to keep on saving these precious moments.

Features:
The app has an official login page!
Can save friends' stories!
You can repost others' posts!
Multi-account supported!
View story captions & tags!
Search users and browse stories!

Story Downloader
This application is a great tool that will help you to download any friend's story in 24 hours. Simply type the person's name, select who you want to download the story, and then click search. You can also save profile pictures of friends by selecting their pictures from the gallery.

Reels Video Downloader
Now you can save reel videos of your favorite stars in high video clarity as well as download highlights, so there's also a Highlight Downloader for easy access to all the best parts of your favorite star.

We are not responsible for any intellectual property violation that results from an unauthorized repost of a video or photo fetched from social media using a story saver. We respect the copyright of the owners. Please get permission from the owner if you want to repost videos or photos. Do not download or re-post the videos and media clips without the owners' permission
